hivequeen.entry.spectrum.name: Colorful Crystals
hivequeen.entry.spectrum.about: It seems that media and colour are more interlinked than I first assumed...
hivequeen.entry.spectrum.text1: All Spectrum gemstone shards and powders can now be used as media! A powder is worth one-fifth its corresponding shard.
hivequeen.entry.spectrum.text2: The three base shards are all equal. An Onyx shard is worth a shard of quenched allay, and a Moonstone shard is worth a charged amethyst.
hivequeen.page.bangle: Routes media through the provided item, breaking a block with all enchantments on it. Costs 1 dust per total enchantment level. The spell will not increase in cost for breaking speed enchantments.
hivequeen.page.barrier: I have devised a method for preventing nature from taking my mind in payment for my hexes. Unfortunately, this is unstable, and quickly unravels after the hex finishes casting. Cast for the first time in a hex, it will prevent me from overcasting. Each subsequent cast in this hex will toggle my ability to overcast. Costs 1 amethyst dust. Obviously, must be cast by a player.
hivequeen.entry.burgeon.name: Burgeon
hivequeen.entry.burgeon.about: I can sense another power sleeping in the earth, beyond my experiments with media and the mind. I wonder what would happen if I tried to simulate this power?
hivequeen.entry.burgeon.spell_descriptio: Well, nothing too earthshattering, but it does induce the growth of several of those mystical flowers I have been seeing around when cast on grass.
hivequeen.plasma.description: A recreation of an old spell. Conjures a volatile beam of plasma. The first vector is the start of the beam, and the second the end of the beam. It will damage entities caught in it, as well as break blocks.
hivequeen.entry.spectrum.about_bangle_br: In addition to other gems being used as media, $(l:patterns/spells/hive_queen_spells)Sympathetic Extraction $(/l) will cost a negligible amount if the provided item has $(4) Curse of the Void.
hivequeen.entry.socks.name: Jeweler's Socks
hivequeen.entry.socks.description: These socks redistribute the ambient flow of media around me, allowing more rings to function.
hivequeen.entry.hive.name: Great Spell Synthesis
hivequeen.entry.hive.intro: If all of the great spells are contained in Nature, than a sufficiently complicated thinking engine should be able to precipitate out the correct patterns, given inspirations to work from. A bee should be perfect for this, for the mind of a bee is already only a fragment of a greater whole.
hivequeen.entry.hive.description: Tossing the items of inspiration around the hive and pressing a large scroll to it will command the engine to begin it's work. $(br2) $(o) All bees are simply the extensions of the same being, The Swarm.
